rules.task_rule: 10-12 continued-text tasks, none of E272's 18 (by Wikipedia language or by source); each from a standard Hugging Face dataset that streams under datasets 4.x without a loading script, pinned to a revision, and packs E272's 2,400 training + 64 held rows of 512 tokens; trained by E272's lm_task unchanged (every token after position 0 trained, E211's read); chosen for spread in expected Pile prevalence (eight Wikipedia languages from well to thinly covered, four English domains that the Pile holds); the list and its reserves written in order before any load check; a candidate that fails to load is replaced by the next reserve of its kind; a task that misses the matched KL or its floor goes to dropped.json, never swapped
rules.test: On the tasks select keeps at E272's KL 'hi' rule: x = the consensus tier code (mean of the two blind raters' codes, reuse 3, middle 2, new 1; score.raters), y = the task's mean effective rank over seeds 0-2 (higher = reuse, E272's filed orientation), z = minus M's base loss in nats per UTF-8 byte on every trained token of the task's 64 held rows (computed in the train job before training; base_loss.loss). Statistic: Kendall's partial tau-b of x and y given z (score.partial_tau). p: one-sided task permutation, y permuted, x and z held, n_perm draws (score.perm_p). Call: 'positive' when partial > 0 and p <= alpha; 'not positive' when partial <= 0; else 'no call'; under min_tasks kept: 'too few tasks'; a nan partial (z tied with x or y perfectly) is 'no call'
rules.power_rule: select writes, before any read: the critical partial tau at the kept n (score.critical_tau's rule over n_crit random orderings of an untied reading, x and z held) and the power at a reading = tier code + sigma N(0,1) with mean raw tau-b 0.3 and 0.5 (score.power's model, z held), with the raw tau-b's critical value and power beside them
rules.beside: reported, no call: raw tau of erank with the tiers, tau of minus loss with the tiers, tau of erank with minus loss, leave-one-task-out partial range
rules.stop: the line ends when the call is 'not positive', or 'no call' with at least 8 tasks kept (card experiments/confirm_panel/card.md)

predictions.why: E272's eight text tasks gave partial 0.87 (p 0.0008), chosen after the data; without summary (a prompt task) E272's seven lm_task text tasks give partial 0.40, with the effective rank's tau with minus loss 0.905 and the loss's with the tier 0.873 (dry run, plan). These twelve are all lm_task tasks, so 0.4 is the realistic size; at n 12 the critical partial is about 0.31-0.35 (dry run, hypothetical tiers) and power at a true tau of 0.5 about 0.56-0.73: a pass is likely only if the E272 pattern is real and not carried by summary

expected.gaussian: each kept task's seed-0 Gaussian erank in 685-720 and above all three of the task's trained states; else STOP

expected.base_loss_nats_per_byte: English domains (pubmed, books, math, stackexchange) about 0.7-1.0 (E272 arxiv 0.78, lower 0.82); Italian, Portuguese, Dutch about 1.0-1.35 (E272 Spanish 1.14, French 1.31, German 1.31); Indonesian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Welsh, Basque about 1.3-2.2 (E272 Swahili 1.60, Yoruba 2.15)
expected.kl_hi_target: about 0.18 (E272's wide KL 'hi' 0.181), set by the rule over these tasks
